paragraphs: (Teima, Genesis 25:15.) He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 4:7, speaking in Rav Hoshaya’s name: “Even regarding family disqualification one begins from the side.” And what Seder HaDorot cites, “Jerusalem Talmud, פא״ד,” where the author of Maskil LeEitan could not locate the place — Hyman explains that it abbreviates “chapter Elu Dinei Mamonot.”

notes.text: Maskil LeEitan is treated as a work title and its author, rather than as an otherwise established rabbi named LeEitan. No unsupported personal identity is added.
The consulted Jerusalem Talmud names the speaker Teima bar Pappayas reporting Rav Hoshaya.
